criteria_origin: S1 owner charter plus explicit S2 engineering proposals; no new owner signature
aggregation: all required gates, no weighted average; current proof cannot substitute other scope

gates.name: Scope and identity
acceptance: Owner scope resolved without authority expansion
Fresh node/boot/PID/source and path ownership
Applicable halt oracle and governance ladder explicitly mapped

gates.name: Durable sensorium and bounded memory
acceptance: Actual batch consumer exercised
Full frozen-input replica boot under quota
Anchored/segmented replay equality with historical divergence preserved
T+1h RSS max <= 1610612736 bytes under preregistered sampling
No OOM, unexplained restart or missing sample

gates.name: Witness and provenance
acceptance: Fresh same-scope signature and loaded-byte checks
Full W1 window with successful probes; sampling limits explicit
Corrupt, stale, forged and replayed witnesses rejected

gates.name: Deployed fleet self-model
acceptance: At least 4 authenticated nodes consumed by deployed self-model; target 7
At least 100 and 160 perform receipt-backed jobs
Stale hub/node/boot change fails to UNKNOWN and grants no authority

gates.name: API budget real caller coverage
acceptance: One USD policy source and stricter runtime wins
Atomic reserve across all paid callers before effect
Crash, retry, timeout, concurrent boundary and currency-mismatch cases pass
Reservations reconcile against provider outcome without freeing unknown liabilities

gates.name: One real end-to-end RevenueRun
acceptance: Real producer-to-consumer chain using same run_id and versioned leg mapping
Required owner release and existing holds enforced
Independent external settlement evidence and reconciliation, not historical payment reattribution
Cost and attribution separately recorded; one payment not intelligence proof

gates.name: Restore and kill-switch drills
acceptance: Consumer operates correctly on isolated restored state
Injected corrupt restore refused
Actual effect-path kill-switch stops effects at all mapped checkpoints in isolated replica
Rollback and second-host witness complete

gates.name: Causal learning and system self-repair
acceptance: Preregistered heldout comparison with fixed budget/model controls
Consumed-memory trace and ablation establish mechanism
Unassisted deployed system closes fault-to-witness cycle; manual intervention reported separately
Effects and uncertainty meet frozen criteria, or honest INCONCLUSIVE
Evaluator and test leakage boundaries independently checked

gates.name: Sustained operation and restart retention
acceptance: Predeclared 24h integrated soak after final relevant change
No invariant violation, lost acknowledged event or unexplained observation gap
Warm/cold process restart preserves authorized state and no duplicate external effect
Observation exposure and false-positive denominators reported
